comment: Low Water live review: a real server on map 8 with rule bots, from eye height in the trench chicane, on both Sabotage approaches and both overwatch decks, a follow camera strip and a joined first-person fighter. Run with FRAGR_QA_MAP=8 FRAGR_QA_BOTS=8 FRAGR_QA_MODE=tdm FRAGR_QA_MANIFEST=res://qa/low_water.json. Camera placement is presentation only; no player pose injection.
